philosophy.title: A Rejection of the Generic
philosophy.content: This portfolio is a rejection of the standard developer aesthetic. No terminal fonts for body text. No neon gradients. No 'bento box' layouts. Instead, it embraces the editorial register — high stroke contrast serifs, generous whitespace, and a deliberate typographic tension that demands attention rather than just surface-level scanning. Precision in code should be reflected by precision in presentation.
